name: branding-apparel-tee-mockup-editorial-interior
title: Two tees on wooden hangers in a warm antique interior
whatItIs: A photo of two t-shirts on hangers: a cream tee with an illustrated Ferris wheel scene and a black tee with a small pixel-star wordmark 'Culture of dreamer's', beside a blue-and-white vase on a wood shelf.
whatItMeans: Curated, lived-in and youthful; the vintage setting makes streetwear feel collectible.
techniques: Show merchandise in a styled interior instead of a flat studio shot.
Vary graphics between a detailed illustration and a tiny wordmark.
Match the set's warm neutrals with the tees.
Use natural light and depth of field for a lifestyle feel.

vocabulary.definition: Product shown in a realistic scene.
A small graphic on the front of a shirt.
Props chosen to support the mood.
A colour variation of a garment.
